svg.aria-label: The card's timed generations: where the time goes
svg.title: The card's timed generations: where the time goes
svg.text: The card's timed generations: where the time goes
One bar a generation: the device opened, weights loaded, 1280128 frames run with 10000 injections,
the records read back and scored, the device closed. Each part as the host timed it.
Authority: neither. A wall clock of one session of this host code on the U50.
